findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation before authorizing reads
findings.body: When `userTenant` differs from `documentTenant`, this function now still returns `true`. Callers relying on this authorization decision can therefore grant cross-tenant document access, breaking tenant isolation. Retain the equality check or enforce an equivalent policy before approving access.

findings.title: [P1] Restore the tenant equality check before granting document access
findings.body:
Any user whose tenant differs from the document tenant now receives `true`, allowing unauthorized cross-tenant document reads and breaking tenant isolation.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation before authorizing document reads
findings.body:
`canReadDocument` now authorizes every request. Any caller relying on this exported access check will permit a user whose `userTenant` differs from `documentTenant` to read another tenant’s documents, breaking tenant isolation.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
